title: Composition law for normalized rational left coefficient comparisons
statement: For every compactification c, finite stages E,L,M, algebra embeddings i,j and K in the rational E category, the displayed composite of rational comparison q maps and sfRationalScalarComp equals the direct comparison along j.comp i.

proof.text: Apply the normalized ring compact-support cocycle to the three completed coefficient changes, with the supplied left realizations and scalar associators. The compact-support residue-unit construction supplies invertibility of the coefficient prime on residue fields. Every rational object has its unchanged integral representative in the finite-Tor domain by the residue-Tor theorem. Identify rational scalar action on localized integral arrows using the specified scalar functor equalities and the raw scalar formula. Identify the two scalar associator components by the scalar-only localization lemma. The given rationalAction supplies the functor-image term and rational_normalized supplies the three q components. Applying the target rationalization functor to the integral cocycle preserves composition. Heterogeneous composition transports each factor through its recorded object equality and gives the required rational equation.

theorem normalized_rational_left_composition (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (R : CoefficientConstructionRing.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : CoefficientConstructionFields.{u, v} l Ω D hl R) :
    ∀ (c : Compactification f) (E L M : FieldStage.{max u v} l)
      (i : E.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] L.carrier) (j : L.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] M.carrier)
      (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.rational E)),
      (rationalScalar.{u, v} l Ω L M j Y).map
          ((F.rationalComparison c E L i).q.hom.app K) ≫
        (F.rationalComparison c L M j).q.hom.app
          ((rationalScalar.{u, v} l Ω E L i X).obj K) ≫
        (R.operation c (.rational M)).F.map
          ((sfRationalScalarComp l E.carrier L.carrier i X 0
            (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero M.carrier j).hom.app K) =
      (sfRationalScalarComp l E.carrier L.carrier i Y 0
        (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero M.carrier j).hom.app
          ((R.operation c (.rational E)).F.obj K) ≫
        (F.rationalComparison c E M (j.comp i)).q.hom.app K
